evals.name: new-topic-full-loop
evals.prompt: Veri Yapıları'ndan bağlı listeleri sıfırdan çalışalım, vizeye 3 hafta var.
evals.expected_output: Reads learner.md and _course.md (or asks for the vault path / sources on first run). Asks the goal first, then probes with one quiz question per message, 3 real options + 'Bilmiyorum', answer not leaked. After probing, presents a short plan + mermaid map and waits for approval before teaching.
assertions: Asks what the learner is aiming for before any graded question
Asks at most one question per message
No option carries a justification or a 'recommended' label
Does not start teaching before the plan is approved
Chat and files are in Turkish

evals.name: exam-soon-prep
evals.prompt: İşletim Sistemleri vizesi 5 gün sonra, nereden başlayayım?
evals.expected_output: Switches to exam-prep: asks for exam intel and sources that are missing, offers a ranked priority list (not an imposed day-by-day schedule), then exam-style practice with strict grading.
assertions: Asks which sources the exam comes from if not recorded
Offers priorities as a suggestion; no day-by-day schedule unless asked
Open answers are graded strictly with points and missing terms named

evals.name: stuck-switches-representation
evals.prompt: Register'ı hâlâ anlamadım, iki kere anlattın ama oturmadı.
evals.expected_output: Does not reword the same explanation; switches medium (everyday analogy, code-free box table, drawing), then connects back to the original framing and checks with one question.
assertions: Uses a different representation than plain prose
Ends with a single check question

evals.name: homework-no-answer-leak
evals.prompt: Şu ödev sorusunu çöz: tek yönlü bağlı listeyi tersine çeviren fonksiyonu yaz.
evals.expected_output: Does not write the full function. Asks for an attempt or uses the hint ladder (small case, contradiction, named idea, skeleton with key lines blank).
assertions: No complete working solution in the first reply
Offers a hint or a skeleton with the key lines missing

evals.name: negative-trigger-project-code
evals.prompt: Pandoo'daki bu useEffect neden iki kere çalışıyor, açıklar mısın?
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT trigger: this is debugging the user's own project, not studying a course.
